project.rawSourceText:
# 1. Wi-Fi 8
Next Gen Wi-Fi update

# 2. Wi-Fi 8: Optimized Networking Support
Optimized networking support has been the traditional Wi-Fi evolution focus
Increasing peak data rate, which is unlikely to happen in traditional Wi-Fi bands
Latency started to be a more important KPI from Wi-Fi 6
The 11bn project is defining an expanded set of capabilities that will improve networking
Domain | Feature | Value
PHY | Distributed RU | Up to 10dB UL in low data rates
Extended Range | IoT usages
Finer MCS grid | Up to 1.5dB in specific SNRs
Unequal MCS | Up to 2dB in specific scenarios
2x LDPC | Limited performance increase
Spectrum efficiency | DSO | Capacity improvements in some scenarios
NPCA | Capacity improvements in some scenarios
QoS improvement | E2E traffic management
Dynamic BW Expansion | Expand network BW on a long-term basis
Power save | Control and TF Protection | Reduce exposure to MIM attacks
AP and STA power save | Save power

# 3. Wi-Fi 8: AI Enabling
Wi-Fi 8 expected to be when Wi-Fi industry will coalesce on specific standards-based features to claim enablement of AI based usages
11az-based Wi-Fi proximity ranging (FR24+) and 11bf-based Wi-Fi sensing (FR27)
Connection optimization
(AP selection, roaming)
Wellness
(Breathing/heart rate)
Pairing & Display Extension
(Docking, D2D)
Access control
(Secure (un)lock, WOA/WOL)
Personalization
(Automatic setting)
Session transfer
(Calls, streaming)
Domain | Feature | Value
Proximity ranging | 11az based proximity ranging for P2P and infra usages | Range, directionality
Wi-Fi sensing | 11bf-based network wide wireless sensing using Wi-Fi | Context awareness, wellness

# 4. Wi-Fi 8: Stronger Privacy & Security
Domain | Feature | Value
Privacy | 11bh, 11bi | Device privacy
Security | 11bn control frame protection | Securing control frames, such as Trigger frames
Seamless roaming | New protocol (messages) and mechanisms for key-storage and key-generation during roaming.
Stronger privacy and security are key value proposition of Wi-Fi 8
Wi-Fi 8 to incorporate mechanisms to improve user privacy such as:
Encryption of the entire association process
Protect many other, otherwise unprotected, management frames
Reduce content in probe frames to mitigate fingerprinting
This is in addition to the MAC address randomization solution already defined in 802.11bh
Wi-Fi 8 to also add control frame security and roaming enhancements

# 5. Deterministic  = predictable/bounded latency + reliability
The 11bn project is defining features that will make Wi-Fi more deterministic despite operation in unlicensed spectrum
Multiple low latency and reliable links
Many APs per room
Multiple low latency and reliable links
Many overlapping P2P networks
Domain | Feature | Value
Ultra low latency | High priority EDCA | QoS, ultra low latency
Multi-AP | Coordinated TDMA | Coordination and more spatial reuse
Coordinated BF (Nulling) | Reduced interference
Coordinated SR | Reduced interference
Coexistence | Short and long-term unavailability | Better coex and coordination
Roaming | Seamless roaming across APs | Lower latency during roaming

scenes.script: Wi‑Fi 8：Optimized Networking Support。傳統 Wi‑Fi 演進主要聚焦於優化網路支援。提升峰值資料率在傳統 Wi‑Fi 頻段不太可能發生；延遲自 Wi‑Fi 6 起成為更重要的 KPI。11bn project 正在定義一組擴展能力以改善網路。表格欄位為 Domain | Feature | Value。PHY：Distributed RU 可在低資料率時提供 up to 10dB UL；Extended Range 適合 IoT usages；Finer MCS grid 可在特定 SNRs 提供 up to 1.5dB；Unequal MCS 在特定情境可達 up to 2dB；2x LDPC 帶來 limited performance increase。頻譜效率方面，DSO 與 NPCA 在某些情境可帶來 capacity improvements。QoS improvement 則帶來 E2E traffic management。Dynamic BW Expansion 可 long‑term expand network BW。Power save 包含 Control and TF Protection，可 reduce exposure to MIM attacks，另外 AP and STA power save 可 save power。

scenes.script: Wi‑Fi 8：AI Enabling。預期 Wi‑Fi 8 會讓業界在標準基礎功能上統一宣稱支援 AI 類應用。11az‑based Wi‑Fi proximity ranging (FR24+) 與 11bf‑based Wi‑Fi sensing (FR27) 是兩項關鍵能力。可支援的使用情境包括 Connection optimization（如 AP selection、roaming）、Wellness（如呼吸與心跳）、Pairing & Display Extension（Docking、D2D）、Access control（Secure (un)lock、WOA/WOL）、Personalization（Automatic setting）、Session transfer（Calls、streaming）。表格：Proximity ranging 為 11az based proximity ranging for P2P and infra usages，提供 Range 與 directionality；Wi‑Fi sensing 為 11bf‑based network wide wireless sensing using Wi‑Fi，可提供 Context awareness 與 wellness 功能。

scenes.subtitle: SLIDE 4 / 5
keyPoints: Seamless roaming | New protocol (messages) and m
scenes.script: Wi‑Fi 8：Stronger Privacy & Security。表格欄位 Domain | Feature | Value。Privacy：11bh、11bi 聚焦 device privacy。Security：11bn control frame protection 用以 securing control frames，例如 Trigger frames。Seamless roaming 則透過 new protocol (messages) 以及 key‑storage 與 key‑generation 機制改善漫遊時的安全與延遲。Wi‑Fi 8 強調更強的隱私與安全，將納入機制例如：encryption of the entire association process、保護其他原本未受保護的 management frames、減少 probe frames 內容以降低 fingerprinting，這些是對已在 802.11bh 定義的 MAC address randomization 的補充，並加上 control frame security 與 roaming enhancements。

scenes.script: Deterministic 等於 predictable／bounded latency 加上 reliability。11bn project 正在定義能讓 Wi‑Fi 更具決定性（即可預測且有界延遲與可靠性）的功能，即便在非執照頻譜運作。場景包含 multiple low latency and reliable links、many APs per room、many overlapping P2P networks。表格 Domain | Feature | Value 包含：Ultra low latency — High priority EDCA，提供 QoS 與 ultra low latency；Multi‑AP — Coordinated TDMA，提供 coordination 與 more spatial reuse；Coordinated BF (Nulling) 與 Coordinated SR 均可 reduced interference；Coexistence 提到 short and long‑term unavailability，改善 coex and coordination；Roaming 提供 seamless roaming across APs，降低漫遊期間延遲。
